blind_spots_patched: Chapters 1-6 omitted material contingent/litigation liabilities (₹31.36 Cr solar EPC arbitration payout exposure, ₹14.88 Cr GST demand under appeal, ~₹16 Cr IBC refund claim against SBI) and recurring consolidated audit exceptions (going-concern Emphasis of Matter at Eltech Engineers Madras, accounting software audit-trail exceptions, and ~₹8 Cr unimpaired goodwill on loss-making Xanatos Marine).

Chapters 1 and 5 neutrally described the MEL Shipyard divestment and emerging subsidiaries without flagging that 70% of MEL Shipyard was sold directly to promoters for a nominal ₹70,000, or that loss-making subsidiaries Evigo Charge and Xanatos Marine absorbed parent guarantees, bad-debt write-offs, and asymmetric loan-to-equity conversions.

Chapters 2 and 3 did not disclose that most of Marine Electricals' order book consists of fixed-price contracts exposed to raw-material inflation across 6-18 month execution windows, nor that audited segment reporting bundles Data Centres inside the broader Industry segment without separate revenue/margin disclosure.

CONFIRMED: High working-capital intensity (178 Debtor Days, 10-year CFO/PAT 44.5%, negative ₹48 Cr cumulative FCF) persists alongside an upgraded [ICRA]A- (Stable) / [ICRA]A2+ rating on ₹419.50 Cr bank limits.
